raw_segments.text: But in a republic, where every magistrate ought to be personally responsible for his
behavior in office the reason which in the British Constitution dictates the propriety
of a council, not only ceases to apply, but turns against the institution.
In the monarchy of Great Britain, it furnishes a substitute for the prohibited responsibility
of the chief magistrate, which serves in some degree as a hostage to the national justice
In the American Republic, it would serve to destroy, or would greatly diminish, the intended
and necessary responsibility of the chief magistrate himself.
